rule: Background 8. A single green (3) seed sits on an edge. Red (2) bars are attached to side edges, with n blue (1) cells alternating from the attached end. Output: all 1s become 2. A green path runs inward from the seed. For each bar, with k = n + 1, it stops k cells before the bar, sidesteps until it is k cells beyond the bar's free end, then resumes. After the last bar it exits at the opposite edge.
scope: Input-constructed edge-seeded path routing around side-attached obstacle bars. Blue marker count plus one sets both forward and lateral clearance. All four directions, 1–4 bars by default and up to 7 requested, native extents 5–30. Explicit latent scenes reconstruct all six canonical examples.

authored_scope: Supported: all four seed edges (via a canonical down frame with rotation or reflection), 1-7 bars (1-4 by default), 1-4 ones per sampled bar (any count via explicit bars), bars on either side with mostly alternating sides, and lateral size 5-30 (7-30 by default). Length runs from tight packing up to 30, with random slack in every gap. Explicit latent bars reconstruct all six fixtures. Sizes beyond the fixtures, the 'up' orientation and border-touching sidestep targets are synthetic extensions of the same rule. Deliberately not supported: floating bars that touch neither side edge, distractor bars that the path never meets, bars in the far-edge row, corner seeds, and stop rows on the seed row.
authored_constraints: Exactly one green cell in the input: the seed, on the start edge, not in a corner.
Every bar spans the path's current lateral coordinate, so the path meets every bar.
Each bar touches exactly one side edge; the sidestep target bound keeps it off the opposite side.
The 1s alternate from the attached end; the bar size is at least max(2, 2n-1).
The first stop row is at least 1. Each later stop row is at least 2 rows past the previous bar, so consecutive bars are at least 4 rows apart and never merge.
The last bar is at most at row length-2, so no bar touches the far edge or a corner.
The sidestep target lies in 0..width-1 and is strictly beyond the free end, so the path never touches a bar.
Integer controls must be non-bool ints; the side must be the string 'L' or 'R'.
Sampling is constructive with no rejection loop: an n=1 bar is always laterally feasible for width >= 5, and 4 rows are reserved per remaining bar.
